evidence.quote: To learn more about OAuth flows, see authentication documentation.
API calls succeed only when made with correct scopes/permissions assigned to the app after the vetting process.
The Advertising API enables developers to manage LinkedIn's campaign management platform on behalf of clients through APIs.
These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.
No mention of an existing Managed Cloud Partner (MCP) for LinkedIn Ads.

output.one_liner: LinkedIn Ads API lets developers programmatically manage campaigns, ad accounts, and analytics on LinkedIn.
output.access_note: App must pass LinkedIn's vetting process and be granted the required scopes/permissions.
output.blocker: Requires LinkedIn API partner vetting and approval before production use.
